think about a simple picture of how things move in space: imagine a place with a ball that has a red ball on it and a green ball on it. The ball is blue because the ball gives light on its own. when a person sits and thinks about what it means to have a real picture of something. The mind may feel that there is some way it can hold up any thought, even if you cannot point to a clear sign or a clear way to see how it works. This feeling that something is true is called having a belief.

When we say someone has a belief, we mean they believe the thing they think is right in their own mind. But a belief is only a feeling in the mind. It does not need a sign, it just needs to be joined with other thoughts that are right.

a belief can be wrong, even though it feels sure. For a case, a person might hear a story from another person, and think the story is true because the first friend said so, and later feel that the story was not true. The belief came from a feeling, not from signs that show it works.

to move from a belief to really know, the person must look at why they hold that belief. They must ask themselves: did they see it happen? do they trust other people? Did they use the thing? If they can show a way to check it again and again, then the belief moves from belief to real knowing. If they cannot show a way, even when the thing is shown, then the person stays only believes, not really knowing.

the key point is that a real knowing has a belief that fits with other things the mind already knows. It also has a reason for being together with the world as it is. In that sense, a person who has a belief without that kind of join is still only believing. If the tie between the belief and the world is not strong, the belief can change easily, and the person stays far from real knowing.

a third thing, a person must have deep ties with other people. This does not mean just being near people, but having people who really know you and love you. when people think about what is true. the first thing we must look at is what it means to believe a thing is true. Many times, a person says a thing is right and they feel very sure about it. This feeling of being sure can be very strong. However, having a strong feeling that something is true does not make that thing true in the real world.

To understand this, we must look for how we know things. We use our eyes, our ears, and our thoughts to learn about the world around us. But our minds can do things that are wrong. Sometimes we see things that are not there, or we think two things are the same when they are not the same. Our minds can also be made to believe things that are because of how we were raised or how we were told by others.

a belief is just a way your mind tells you that something is right. If you believe the moon is made of a soft white food that people eat, you will feel very sure. You might even tell everyone else that you are right. But the moon is still not made of that food. The truth did not change just because you felt sure. The way the world works stays the same no matter how much you believe in a thing.

can a person be very sure and still be completely wrong? Think about a man who looks at a small part of a large tree. He sees a shape on a wall. He feels very sure that the whole tree is just like that one. He might even feel very sure that he has seen the whole tree. But he only saw a tiny part of it. His feeling of being certain was very big, but it did not show that the whole house is different. The feeling of being right came from what was already inside his head, not from what was outside in the world.

First, we must understand what truth is. Truth is about how things are in the world. If i say that the sky is green, that thing is not true. It does not matter if i say it one time or if i say a very large number of times. The color of the sky does not change because of my words. The sky stays blue because that is what it is. The words do not have the power to change the world.

second, we must see how our minds work. When we hear the same thing many times often, our brains get used to it. It feels easy to believe something we already know well. When a thought comes into our head without much work, we stop asking if it is right. We just accept it as if it were real. But feeling like something is right is not the same as it being true. a feeling can be strong, but a feeling cannot change what is real.

third, we must ask why this happens. People often use words to make others believe them. If you say a lie many times, your mind might start to feel like the lie is real. This happens because our brains like things that are easy to remember. It becomes hard for us to take the idea away from what we already know to be true. We put together what is easy with what is actually real.
